new_page.h1: Nordel Houses for Sale | North Delta Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Nordel. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Nordel, North Delta: 57 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 10 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 1 of 4 North Delta communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Nordel fell from 67 in June to 57 in October (−14.9%), and 47 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 30.5% of North Delta’s 187 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Nordel?
Nordel also had 16 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in October, against 57 houses listed. The Nordel condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Nordel home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

81 houses sold in Nordel with a median price of $1,200,000 (the middle half sold between $1,110,000 and $1,300,000), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 95.7% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $488 per square foot, a median year built of 1974 and a median lot of 7,168 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Nordel?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 57 houses listed in Nordel. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Nordel a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Nordel had a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Nordel from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 47 houses sold in Nordel over those 5 months, out of 154 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Nordel?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Nordel sell for?
faq.a: 81 houses sold in Nordel between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,200,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Nordel?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.7% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
